infoTagline: Free music, no ads · Free forever
infoAboutBody: Velqi is a free, open-source music player that streams and downloads songs from YouTube Music — no ads, no account needed. It uses an embedded engine (Python + yt-dlp) to fetch high-quality audio, with a clean, fast and customizable interface.
infoNotifOkBody: Music controls appear in the notification bar while playing.

infoLicenseBody: Velqi is free software, released under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
infoReport: Report bugs or suggest ideas on GitHub 💜
changelog131_1: Update notifications now come from the official website (velqi.netlify.app): the app notifies you automatically when a new version is available.
changelog131_2: Faster and more reliable version check.
changelog131_3: License updated: personal use, all rights reserved.
changelog130_1: Playback fixed (critical bug): audio formats are now obtained with yt-dlp automatic format negotiation.
changelog130_2: yt-dlp updated to 2026.07.04 and pinned for reproducible builds.
changelog130_3: Songs that cut off or paused mid-way: the backend no longer blocks requests (concurrent server) and network error recovery is more reliable.
changelog130_4: Crash on app reopen fixed: resilient startup and corrupted-data recovery.
changelog130_5: Music control notifications fixed on Android 13+: the channel is created with high importance and recreated when the permission is granted.
changelog130_6: New «About Velqi» page with credits, what's new and license.
changelog130_7: ⚡ Fast Mode now actually works: reduces network timeouts so songs start sooner (available from the home button and Settings).
changelog130_8: New animated splash: «LUPYTHER presents» with logo, equalizer and engine progress bar.
changelog130_9: Grey loading screen fixed: the home screen never stays frozen — it always ends up showing content, a «Preparing Velqi…» notice while the engine starts, or a retry button if the connection fails.
changelog130_10: UI redesigned: the bottom navigation bar and the mini player now form a single integrated dock.
changelog130_11: Player collapse button fixed: now drops to the mini player instantly (the animation used to hang).
changelog130_12: Light mode fixed: the interface now adapts correctly (queue, settings and mini player).
changelog130_13: The Info page is now translated into the essential languages (EN, ES, PT, FR, DE, IT).
changelog122_1: Crash on app reopen fixed (Python backend no longer starts twice).
changelog121_1: Exporting music to device fixed (storage permission on Android 11+).
changelog121_2: Notifications fixed: channel and POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission.
changelog121_4: Memory leak, download and error-handling fixes.
darkThemeExperimentalDes: Switch between dark and light theme
fastModeDes: Lower quality + short timeouts. Ideal for slow connections or avoiding cuts when skipping songs quickly.
cookiesPcSteps:
1. Sign in to youtube.com with Chrome
2. Install the 'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY' extension
3. Click the extension → Export cookies
4. Open the downloaded file, select all and copy it
5. Paste it in the field below and press Apply
cookiesAndroidSteps:
1. Download Kiwi Browser (supports extensions)
2. Install 'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY' from the web store
3. Open music.youtube.com and sign in
4. Tap the extension → Export → copy the content

cookiesNotAccepted: YouTube rejected these cookies. Export a fresh cookies.txt while signed in to music.youtube.com.
